description: This file contains unit tests for the Stream Generator Provider in an Orleans-based streaming application. It includes setup for test fixtures, stream configuration, and validation of generated streams and event delivery.

classes.name: StreamGeneratorProviderTests
classes.description: A test class for validating the functionality of the stream generator provider in Orleans, including stream generation and event delivery verification.

classes.name: StreamGeneratorProviderTests.Fixture
classes.description: A fixture class setting up the Orleans test cluster with specific stream provider configurations for the tests.

methods.name: ValidateGeneratedStreamsTest
methods.description: A test method that validates if the streams are generated as expected and the counters are correct.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: A helper method that checks the stream counters and verifies the expected number of streams and events per stream.
